sentences.en: It essentially says, I know that this is a no for me
sentences.zh: 它本质上是在说，我知道对我来说这是一个“不”，

sentences.en: and it's an unwavering stance.
sentences.zh: 而且这是一个坚定不移的立场。

sentences.en: In contrast, and very commonly used,
sentences.zh: 相比之下，非常常见的一种做法是

sentences.en: is to look for an excuse and say, I'm sorry, I can't.
sentences.zh: 寻找借口并说：“对不起，我不能。”

sentences.en: I can't very often begs the question, why not?
sentences.zh: “我不能”往往会引发一个问题：为什么不能？

sentences.en: And then you get into all the external reasons as to why you are unable to take this on.
sentences.zh: 然后你就会陷入所有外部原因的讨论，解释你为什么无法承担这件事。

sentences.en: And it opens a discussion and it invites negotiation.
sentences.zh: 这会开启一场讨论，并招致谈判。

sentences.en: What I've shown in my research is that when you say I don't, you shut that down.
sentences.zh: 我在研究中证明的是，当你用“我不要”时，你就切断了这种可能。

sentences.en: You essentially say, this is my way.
sentences.zh: 你本质上是在说，这就是我的方式。

sentences.en: This is what I believe.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的信仰。

sentences.en: And people don't argue with who you are.
sentences.zh: 而人们不会去和你的本质争论。

sentences.en: You say that it's also best to avoid giving excuses when we say no.
sentences.zh: 你说最好在说“不”时也避免给出借口。

sentences.en: What do you mean by this and how do you operationalize this, Vanessa?
sentences.zh: 你这是什么意思？你又该如何将其实际应用呢，凡妮莎？

sentences.en: So we have learned that when we want to say no, we often lean on an excuse.
sentences.zh: 所以我们已经了解到，当我们想说“不”时，我们经常依赖借口。

sentences.en: I ran an experiment where people read a scenario that they were looking to borrow $1,500 from a friend.
sentences.zh: 我做过一个实验，让人们阅读一个场景：他们想向朋友借 1500 美元。

sentences.en: And their friend, in different situations, told them different things.
sentences.zh: 而他们的朋友在不同的情况下，对他们说了不同的话。

sentences.en: In one situation where the friend invoked a personal policy, the friend essentially said, I'm sorry, I'm not going to loan you the money, which essentially said,
sentences.zh: 在一种情况下，朋友援引了一项个人原则，朋友基本上说：“对不起，我不会借给你钱”，这实际上是说，

sentences.en: this is my policy about loaning money to friends.
sentences.zh: 这就是我关于借钱给朋友的原则。

sentences.en: Compared to the excuse where the friend essentially said, I'm really sorry, I can't give you the money because I need to use that money that I'm saving up for graduate school.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，在那个借口情境中，朋友基本上说：“真的非常对不起，我不能把钱借给你，因为我需要用这笔钱，我正在为读研究生攒钱。”

sentences.en: What I asked people was whether the refusal was effective.
sentences.zh: 我问人们的是，这种拒绝是否有效。

sentences.en: In both cases, the refusal was effective in the sense people went away and said, okay, fine, I'm not getting the money.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，拒绝都是有效的，因为人们走开时会说：“好吧，好吧，我借不到钱了。”

sentences.en: The critical thing I was looking at was whether 10 years from now you need money again, would you go back and ask that friend for money?
sentences.zh: 我关注的关键点是，如果 10 年后你再次需要用钱，你还会回头找那个朋友借钱吗？

sentences.en: and as you might imagine when somebody used the excuse something that was temporary something that
sentences.zh: 正如你可能想象的那样，当某人使用借口时——某种暂时的、

sentences.en: was external to them people said yeah I'll ask that friend because presumably you know they've
sentences.zh: 对他们而言是外部的事物——人们会说：“会的，我会去问那个朋友”，因为据推测你知道的，他们

sentences.en: paid for graduate school when when the person invoked a personal policy people were less likely
sentences.zh: 已经读完研究生了；而当这个人援引个人原则时，人们不太可能会

sentences.en: significantly less likely to go back and ask them for money so a personal policy essentially just
sentences.zh: 显著不太可能会回头找他们借钱。所以个人原则本质上只是

sentences.en: conveys your stance on a matter and shuts the door, not only in the moment, but for the long run.
sentences.zh: 传达了你对某事的立场，并把门关上了，不仅在当下，而且从长远来看也是如此。

sentences.en: So beyond simply getting out of tasks that we'd rather not spend our time on,
sentences.zh: 因此，除了单纯地摆脱那些我们宁愿不把时间花在上面的任务之外，

sentences.en: what I think I'm really hearing from you, Vanessa, is that the power to say no is central
sentences.zh: 我想我从你这里真正听到的是，说“不”的力量对于

sentences.en: to carving out our own destiny.
sentences.zh: 开创我们自己的命运至关重要。

sentences.en: Learning to say no is part of defining who we are and what we want
sentences.zh: 学会说“不”是定义我们是谁以及我们对生活

sentences.en: out of life.
sentences.zh: 有什么诉求的一部分。

sentences.en: I absolutely agree.
sentences.zh: 我完全赞同。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I think that how we spend our days is how we spend
sentences.zh: 我认为我们如何度过每一天，就是我们如何度过

sentences.en: our lives.
sentences.zh: 我们的人生。

sentences.en: And so the things that we spend our time on, on a daily basis, adds up to how we've
sentences.zh: 因此，我们在日常生活中花时间做的事情，总加起来就是我们

sentences.en: spent our lives.
sentences.zh: 度过一生的方式。

sentences.en: So I agree with you that saying no is very much about creating the destiny that
sentences.zh: 所以我同意你的看法，说“不”很大程度上就是在创造我们

sentences.en: we want for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 为自己想要的人生。
